description: 大阪府が管理する道路 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大阪府. 大阪府が管理する道路について、路線名と管理する土木事務所名を記載した一覧です。. Coverage: 大阪府. The portal files it under the publisher 大阪府. Its tags are 一覧, 道路. It offers 2 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2021-07-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
